variables.QUESTION:
Q7) Definite integral + average value + plot with shading
Let f(x)=x^3 - 3x on [-2, 2].
Tasks:
1) Find all real roots of f(x).
2) Determine where f(x) is positive/negative on [-2,2].
3) Compute the definite integral ∫_{-2}^{2} f(x) dx exactly.
4) Interpret the integral as signed area.
5) Compute the total area between curve and x-axis on [-2,2].
6) Compute the average value of f on [-2,2].
7) Find c in [-2,2] such that f(c)=average value (numerically if needed).
8) Plot f(x) on [-2,2].
9) Shade regions above and below the x-axis differently (conceptually).
10) Draw a horizontal line at the average value.
11) Mark roots and label them.
12) Include title, axes labels, grid, legend.
